subject.title: fix(macos): defer cookie import banner until inline browser opens

question: Is the supplied macOS regression suite enough to override the external-PR real-behavior-proof gate, or must the contributor provide signed-app evidence before merge?
rationale: The implementation now appears correct from source and regression coverage, but the repository policy normally requires real after-fix behavior proof for this external native UI timing change and the PR has a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Require signed-app proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted recording, runtime log, or linked artifact demonstrates the three timing states on the final head.

options.title: Approve a proof override
options.body: A qualified owner may explicitly accept the macOS tests and runner evidence as sufficient when signed-app capture is impractical.

recommendation.title: Require signed-app proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted recording, runtime log, or linked artifact demonstrates the three timing states on the final head.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the recently merged browser-import banner history and are the only evidence-backed routing candidate in the supplied current-main history.
